evals.prompt: /explain how is this project organized and where do I find what?
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML explainer answering the structural question, saved to the resolved scratch folder, plus a one-paragraph chat reply with a clickable link.
expectations: An HTML file is created whose name matches the pattern YYYY-MM-DD-hh-mm-ss-<short-title>.html
The HTML file is self-contained: it has no external <script src>, <link href>, CDN, or font URLs
The document contains a plain-language summary block as its first content block
The document contains at least one table or one inline SVG diagram
The document contains at least one collapsible source-citation widget (a <details> block) and a Sources section listing files that were read
The document carries the not-canonical banner
The document substantively and accurately answers how the project is organized (grader judgment against the actual project structure)
The chat reply is roughly one paragraph and includes a clickable link/path to the generated file

evals.prompt: /explain --simple how do people work together and keep track of their work in this project?
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML explainer about the project's working/collaboration conventions, written jargon-free for a non-technical reader.
expectations: An HTML file is created whose name matches the pattern YYYY-MM-DD-hh-mm-ss-<short-title>.html
The HTML file is self-contained (no external script/style/font/CDN URLs)
The document opens with a plain-language summary and substantively answers the collaboration/workflow question (grader judgment)
The document is written without unexplained technical jargon, consistent with the --simple flag (grader judgment)
The document includes source citations grounded in real project files (Sources section is non-empty and paths resolve)

evals.expected_output: A small chat table of the user's previously generated explainers (or a clear 'none yet' message), with no new HTML file generated.
expectations: No new HTML explainer document is generated for this invocation
The response is a chat-only listing (table of past explainers) or a plain 'no explainers yet' message when the folder is empty or missing
